examples.japanese: {大学|だいがく}{受験|じゅけん}のために{予備校|よびこう}に{通|かよ}っている。
examples.english: I am attending prep school for university entrance exams.

examples.japanese: {浪人|ろうにん}して{予備校|よびこう}で{一年|いちねん}{勉強|べんきょう}した。
examples.english: I took a gap year and studied at prep school for a year.

examples.japanese: {予備校|よびこう}の{夏期|かき}{講習|こうしゅう}に{参加|さんか}する。
examples.english: I will participate in the prep school's summer intensive course.

notes:
{予備校|よびこう} is specifically for students preparing for university entrance exams, especially {浪人生|ろうにんせい} (gap year students who are retaking exams).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {予備校|よびこう}に{通|かよ}う (attend prep school)
- {予備校|よびこう}に{入|はい}る (enter prep school)
- {予備校|よびこう}の{模試|もし} (prep school mock exam)
- {予備校|よびこう}{講師|こうし} (prep school instructor)

CONTRAST WITH {塾|じゅく}:
- {塾|じゅく}: For students of all ages, various subjects
- {予備校|よびこう}: Primarily for high school students and {浪人生|ろうにんせい} targeting university entrance exams

FAMOUS {予備校|よびこう}:
- {駿台|すんだい}{予備校|よびこう}
- {河合|かわい}{塾|じゅく}
- {代々木|よよぎ}ゼミナール

definitions.gloss: prep school, preparatory school (for university entrance exams)
